messages.content: we also took this back on the back of an ET so we cannot ET and ET

Hi Team,

This is a PSR customer who mistakenly filed for the switch due to their medical condition and didn't intend to do so. Their relative has since gotten in touch to inform us that they want to switch back to us and make it so that it's like they never left Fuse. Hence, an ET request is due here. Please treat this as a goodwill customer return for a PSR customer. 

Thanks
the cancellation was after the Start date so as per FMRS this needs to be a new COS back to you and not an ET

Hi, we have been contacted by the customer who has said that she requested a switch to Fuse and that due to having Alzheimer's she then cancelled the switch when this was queried by yourselves. Please allow the transfer as customer is keen to switch back to Fuse. Let us know if you need any further info
